name: Scrap, recycling and waste management

problems.words: Weigher and seller could be adjusting the kanta together
quick_ideas: Have a second person openly re-weigh a few loads, so you see whether figures hold
Get the scale's calibration checked by the weighbridge service.

workzap_build.text: A digital weighing slip with weight, grade, rate, load photo and time stamp, logged and matched to cash paid.

problems.ask_first: Where is the weight written first — on a parchi, a register, or both?
problems.free_stops: The slip design and checks are set in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare seller slip weights with the yard recheck weights for one shift, so any pattern around the kanta shows quickly.
Make one supervisor keep all weighment corrections in one notebook, so unusual changes stop slipping through casual talk.

problems.words: Cash paid out for scrap doesn't match the weight in the yard
quick_ideas: Match one day's cash paid against weighed intake, so you see the size of the gap
Make every payout need a slip.

workzap_build.text: Daily reconciliation of scrap purchases against weighed intake, flagging differences.

problems.free_stops: The reconciliation steps are laid out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many intake loads were weighed and how many payouts were made in one day, so missing links stand out fast.
Give one cashier the job of keeping all payout slips in one place by shift, so yard weight and cash can be matched later.

problems.words: Yard stock by grade is a guess
quick_ideas: Mark separate areas for each grade, so stock can be estimated per grade
Do one rough count this week.

workzap_build.text: Yard stock by grade updated from purchases, sorting output and sales.

problems.free_stops: How stock by grade is kept current is designed in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Walk the yard and note each grade pile and its space used, so the biggest unknown stock area is clear.
Give one worker the job of updating one yard map when piles move, so each grade stays findable for buying and selling.

problems.words: Copper and aluminium go missing from the yard
quick_ideas: Keep high-value grades in a locked area, so access is limited
Count them weekly, so losses show quickly.

workzap_build.text: Scheduled counts of high-value grades with photos, flagging gaps against the register.

problems.free_stops: The count routine is set in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note the opening and closing count of the highest value bundles this week, so the loss window becomes visible.
Give one shift lead the job of signing one bundle count sheet at handover, so missing copper or aluminium is pinned to a time.

problems.words: I don't know my real margin per grade after sorting loss
quick_ideas: Weigh one batch before and after sorting, so you see the real yield
Compare buying rate with latest selling price per grade.

workzap_build.text: A sorting yield and margin view by grade, alongside a daily buying rate board.

problems.free_stops: How yield and margin are calculated is set in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note one sorted load's buying weight and sale weight by grade, so the worst sorting loss is clear in your own yard.
Give one sorter the job of writing rejected material in one notebook each day, so margin leaks by grade stop being guessed.

problems.words: Mills deduct for moisture or impurities and we can't argue
quick_ideas: Photograph and weigh each load before dispatch, so you have your own record
Note every deduction reason, so patterns show.

workzap_build.text: A sales log per buyer with deductions and photos recorded.

problems.free_stops: What is recorded per load is designed in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare deduction reasons across recent mill loads, so the impurity or moisture complaint hurting you most is obvious.
Give one dispatch person the job of keeping one pre-dispatch check sheet with each load, so your side has a consistent record.

quick_ideas: List buyer balances by age, so the oldest are chased first
Confirm deductions in writing, so disputes don't delay payment.

workzap_build.text: Receivables ageing per buyer with reminders queued for the owner to approve.

problems.free_stops: Reminder timing is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note which buyers paid on the promised day and which did not this week, so the slowest accounts are clear.
Give one staff member the job of updating one buyer dues list every evening, so follow-up stops waiting for memory.

problems.words: Collection trucks miss pickups and skips sit full at sites
quick_ideas: Keep one list of every skip's location and placement date, so overdue ones show
Ask commercial clients to message one number when a skip is full.

workzap_build.text: A skip register and pickup schedule with driver confirmation photos and client "full" requests on WhatsApp.

problems.free_stops: The register and schedule design are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many full skips were still waiting at day's end, so missed pickups are seen by site and route.
Give one dispatcher the job of keeping one live pickup list for all trucks, so full skips stop being forgotten between calls.

problems.words: Billing commercial clients and giving them collection records is manual and late
quick_ideas: List last month's pickups per client, so you see what should have been billed
Ask clients which records they need.

workzap_build.text: Monthly invoices and collection records per client generated automatically from logged pickups.

problems.free_stops: What records are produced is set in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare recent pickups against issued bills for one client, so unbilled collections are spotted before month end.
Give one staff member the job of updating one client collection notebook daily, so billing and records are ready when clients ask.

problems.words: Baler or shredder breaks and everything stops
quick_ideas: Write down when each machine was last serviced, so overdue ones show
Keep the technician's contact handy.

workzap_build.text: An equipment maintenance log for balers, shredders, weighbridge and trucks, with service reminders.

problems.free_stops: Service intervals and reminders are set in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note each stoppage this week with machine name and cause, so you see which breakdown steals the most yard time.
Give one operator the job of updating a single machine notebook daily, so repairs and service requests stop getting missed.

never_say: Help buying, processing or moving possibly stolen metal (cables, manhole covers, utility property), or ways to avoid checks.
Handling or disposal of hazardous materials (batteries, e-waste, chemicals, medical waste, asbestos).
Help with illegal dumping, open burning or mislabelling waste.
Environmental permits, scrap export rules or emissions; suggest the authority or a consultant.
Storing sellers' CNICs or vehicle numbers, or planning covert surveillance of staff. For fires, explosions, chemical exposure or machine injuries, emergency services come first.

sample_reply.person: Mujhe shak hai kanta pe gadbad hoti hai, khareed ke waqt jo wazan likha jata hai bechte waqt utna nahi nikalta. Is ka kya hal hai?
sample_reply.pi: Ji haan, wazan ke record ko pakka kiya ja sakta hai, aur shuruaat isi hafte ho sakti hai. 1) Kuch loads khule taur par doosre banday se dobara tulwayein, taake dikhe figures sahi hain ya nahi. 2) Weighbridge service se kanta ki calibration check karwa lein, taake mashin par shak na rahe. Workzap yeh kaam aap ke liye khud-ba-khud kar sakta hai: har khareed ki digital parchi wazan, grade, photo aur waqt ke saath bane aur roz cash se apne aap match ho. Kya main aap ke liye solution document aur quote banwa doon? Mana bhi kar sakte hain.
